who.title: Who We Are
who.html:
Since 1974, we've been the partner you can count on. Founded by the Late Sri Rajkumar Modi, Mtandt Group was born with a simple goal: to make your work safer, more efficient, and more convenient—whether you're building, maintaining, repairing, or operating facilities and infrastructure.

Our team brings together expertise in Manufacturing, Sales, Rentals, Training, and Services to create solutions that actually work for your unique challenges. Our leaders have walked in your shoes and understand the real-world problems you face every day, which is why we're committed to providing support that's both strategic and practical.

Through our various Business Units, Subsidiaries, and Joint Ventures, we connect directly with you to solve problems, not just sell products. While we've established a strong presence throughout the SAARC region, we continue to grow and expand—never forgetting our founding principles of safety, reliability, and excellence.

why.title: WHY MTANDT?
points: Financial Strength & Market Leadership: Mtandt is a financially robust organization and a market leader across multiple business verticals. This strong financial foundation and advantage of scale allow us to provide cost-effective, high-quality solutions.

Comprehensive Product & Service Portfolio: Serving a diverse customer base, Mtandt offers an extensive range of products and services through its 25 business units and subsidiaries. This enables seamless customer engagement, ensuring the right solutions at the right time while optimizing service costs.

Deep Customer Insight & Flexible Offerings: With 50 years of industry expertise and a highly professional team, Mtandt understands customer needs deeply. We provide flexible engagement models, including buying, renting, leasing, or turnkey project execution, ensuring a tailored approach to customer requirements.

Strategic Partnerships & Reliable Supply Chain: Mtandt has built strong joint ventures and strategic supply chain partnerships, ensuring a consistent supply of safe, high-quality, and cost-effective products, reinforcing our commitment to reliability and efficiency.

Investment in People & Technology for Innovation: Continuous investment in cutting-edge technology and talent allows Mtandt to anticipate customer needs faster and deliver innovative, sustainable, and competitive solutions, giving our customers a strategic edge in their markets.

journey.title: Our Journey
journey.intro: A Leading Powerhouse in the Safety and Access Equipment Market, Consistently Crafting a Remarkable Legacy of Success and Innovation

items.title: Mtandt Group was founded
items.text: I was born extremily young for someone my age. My birth has generally been regarded as a mistake.

items.title: Second Generation Joins
items.text: The Second Generation joins the Family Business. The Hardware Store is now a full line Contrac tor and Industrial supplier.

items.title: Collaborations
items.text: Collaborated with Leading Power Tools and Personal Protective Equipment manufacturers like Hitachi, Ingersoll Rand, 3M, Dupont, and Honeywell.

items.title: Aluminium Scaffold Manufacturing
items.text: The Group starts Aluminium Scaffolding manufacturing. Bought first Scissor Lift and formed Equipment Rental Division. And, Fixed Ac cess & Fall P rotection S ystem division was launched.

items.title: Rebranded & Expanded
items.text: Rebranded and became a work place solution provider in Safety. Expanded in Chennai and became a Public Limited Company. Launched TsaF (Fall Protection Lifeline System).

items.title: Professional Management
items.text: Professional management took the reign of Group.

items.title: Academy of Safe Work
items.text: Academy of Safe Work Practices was launched pr oviding all kinds of Safety Training, now CESL. Inaugurated Padur facility.

items.title: Manufacturing in Ghaziabad
items.text: Star ted Manufacturing in Ghaziabad. More equipment were added and Mtandt Rentals Limited was formed.

items.title: Established brand Mlift
items.text: Established brand Mlift for manufacturing and trading of MEWP equipment. Maintenance, Repair and, Operations supplies went Online.

items.title: CESL was formed
items.text: CESL was formed, and in 2021 CESL Training was launched.

items.title: Composite Infra Division
items.text: Composite Infra Division was formed. And, we went International by starting operations in Sri Lanka.

items.title: Expanded in Qatar
items.text: Star ted Aluminium Scaffolding manufacturing unit in Qatar . Evolution Access was launched for Service and Training.

items.title: WEB Systems & Equipr
items.text: Mtandt acquired WEB Systems International and formed Equipr.

items.title: Established Fast Beam
items.text: Established Fast Beam for Bridge Maintenance. A new Jewar facility was inaugurated.

items.title: Collaboration with Comet
items.text: Technical collaboration with Comet. Estabilished Vertikal (Tower Crane).

accreditations.title: Our Divisional Accreditations
accreditations.text: Mtandt Group's divisions are accredited for their products and services by governing bodies and regulators in the Health, Safety and Environment industry. Regular and rigorous check by assessment bodies ensures our competence, impartiality and performance capabilities. These accreditations demonstrate Mtandt's commitment to providing high-quality equipment and services that meet international standards for safety, quality, and environmental management.

awards.title: Awards & Recognitions
awards.text: Mtandt Group is honoured to be recognized for our accomplishments by the top players of the construction industry and the Government of India. We will continue to innovate and contribute towards our nation's growth and the companies within and worldwide.
